nodes.summary: The equal-rates GTR transition function is the Jukes–Cantor transition probability `jcProb μ t` (by `JukesCantor.jcProb_eq_exp`).
nodes.title: Equal-rates GTR chain is the Jukes–Cantor model

nodes.summary: The F81 rate matrix (Felsenstein 1981): rate `π j` to every other base `j`.
nodes.title: F81 rate matrix

nodes.summary: Equal base frequencies `1/4` and equal exchangeabilities `4 μ / 3` give the Jukes–Cantor rate matrix `jcRateMatrix μ`.
nodes.title: JC69 is the equal-rates GTR model

nodes.summary: The GTR rate matrix (Tavaré 1986) with base frequencies `π` and exchangeabilities `s`: `s i j * π j` off the diagonal and minus the off-diagonal row sum on it. The diagonal of `s` is not used.
nodes.title: General time-reversible (GTR) rate matrix

nodes.summary: The HKY85 exchangeabilities: `κ` for a transition (indices of equal parity: `A ↔ G`, `C ↔ T` in the order `A, C, G, T`), `1` for a transversion. The diagonal (also `κ`) is not used by `gtrRate`.
nodes.title: HKY85 exchangeabilities

nodes.summary: HKY85 with `κ = 1` is F81.
nodes.title: HKY85 with κ = 1 is F81

nodes.summary: The HKY85 rate matrix (Hasegawa–Kishino–Yano 1985) with base frequencies `π` and transition/transversion ratio `κ`: rate `κ π j` for a transition to `j`, `π j` for a transversion.
nodes.title: HKY85 rate matrix

nodes.summary: Detailed balance of the GTR transition function with the base frequencies, `π i P t i j = π j P t j i` for every `t` (time-reversibility of the GTR chain).
nodes.title: Time-reversibility of the GTR chain

nodes.summary: F81 is in detailed balance with its base frequencies.
nodes.title: Detailed balance of the F81 model

nodes.summary: With symmetric exchangeabilities, the GTR matrix is in detailed balance with its base frequencies, `π i Q i j = π j Q j i` (Tavaré 1986).
nodes.title: GTR is reversible

nodes.summary: HKY85 is in detailed balance with its base frequencies.
nodes.title: Detailed balance of the HKY85 model

nodes.summary: With nonnegative base frequencies, the F81 matrix is a rate matrix.
nodes.title: F81 matrix is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: With nonnegative base frequencies and nonnegative off-diagonal exchangeabilities, the GTR matrix is a rate matrix (the diagonal `s i i` is not used by `gtrRate`).
nodes.title: GTR matrix is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: With nonnegative base frequencies and `κ ≥ 0`, the HKY85 matrix is a rate matrix.
nodes.title: HKY85 matrix is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: For `μ ≥ 0` the Jukes–Cantor matrix is a rate matrix.
nodes.title: Jukes–Cantor matrix is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: With `κ ≥ 0`, the K80 matrix is a rate matrix.
nodes.title: K80 matrix is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: K80 with `κ = 1` is JC69 with substitution rate `μ = 3/4`.
nodes.title: K80 with κ = 1 is the Jukes–Cantor model

nodes.summary: The K80 rate matrix (Kimura 1980): equal base frequencies `1/4`, rate `κ / 4` for a transition and `1 / 4` for each transversion.
nodes.title: K80 rate matrix

nodes.summary: The rows of the GTR matrix sum to `0`, for all parameters.
nodes.title: Rows of the GTR rate matrix sum to zero

nodes.summary: The base frequencies are stationary for the GTR transition function at every time.
nodes.title: Base frequencies are stationary for the GTR chain

nodes.summary: The base frequencies are invariant for the GTR generator: `π Q = 0`.
nodes.title: Base frequencies are invariant for the GTR generator

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
